release: Nigeria review (25 Nov): Lagos and Abuja stay 'collecting'. No new record passed the gates. A Q3 2026 listing-portal market report with per-bed-type yields and listing counts (Abuja 2-bed 7.5%, Lagos 3-bed 7.2%) was read but held: its terms require credit by name, which AMB's no-provider-names rule does not allow, its robots.txt could not be checked, and its dates are inconsistent. Knight Frank gives Nigeria-wide yields only (residential 5.5%, office 8.5%), not Lagos or Abuja. Existing Lagos records unchanged

rejected.item: Accra sponsored property features and developer return claims (2025-2026)

rejected.item: Cairo 2-bed gross yields from a commercial real-estate data seller (page updated 21 Sep 2026, May 2026 snapshot)
rejected.reason: Listing-portal derived (same underlying portals as the existing yield table, so not an independent cross-check); no per-district listing counts; table mixes 'average' and 'median' wording; commercial seller of data packs. Direction agrees with existing records for New Cairo, Heliopolis, 6th of October and Sheikh Zayed; not entered. Its Mohandessin (12.5%) and Dokki/Downtown/Haram/Faisal figures are unverified.

rejected.item: Cairo Rent Price Index, Q2 2026 (Marsad Omran, first edition; read via a news report, 22 Jul 2026)
rejected.reason: Rents only (no prices or yields); sample 18,000+ listings across 26 neighbourhoods but no per-district counts; read via secondary news summary, not the index itself. Not entered. Useful context: city median rent EGP 10,000/month; New Cairo rents reported down 25% y/y.

rejected.item: Kigali neighbourhood gross yields from a real-estate agency blog (published 27 Mar 2026, 'indicative Q1 2026 estimates')
rejected.reason: Marketing content with no sample size, no per-district listing counts and no method beyond 'aligned with NISR indices'; yield ranges (Nyarutarama 5-7%, Kimironko 9-11%, Gasabo emerging 10-12%) are wide ranges, not medians; no price per m2. Fails the 20-listing and evidence gates.

rejected.item: Kigali crowdsourced property database (page updated 17 Nov 2026)
rejected.reason: Grade D: 57 entries from 9 contributors over 18 months, only city-centre vs outside-centre splits, no districts, no price per m2. Implied gross yields 4.58% (centre) and 3.16% (outside) differ from the agency guide by far more than the 25% cross-source limit, so the two cannot be reconciled.

rejected.item: Kigali yields from a January 2018 research report
rejected.reason: Stale (data from 2017-2018, far beyond the 120-day limit); yields by sector not district; residential figure inconsistent within the report (8.1% / 8.2% / 9.0%).

rejected.item: Q3 2026 Nigerian listing-portal market report (asking prices; published 7 Aug 2026, updated 28 Sep 2026)
rejected.reason: Held, not entered. Grade C data with listing counts (e.g. Abuja 2-bed 7.5% on 720 listings, Lagos 3-bed 7.2% on 10,158), but city-and-bed-count rows, not districts; the report is free to use only with named credit, which conflicts with AMB's no-provider-names rule; robots.txt and terms could not be checked; the report is dated both 'published 7 Aug' and 'covering to 30 Sep'; area-level rows were only read via a model-extracted summary. Owner decision needed on credit and robots check.

rejected.item: Knight Frank Africa Report 2026/27, Nigeria page (residential 5.5%, office 8.5%, retail 9.5% yields; Lagos prime office US$55 per m2 a month)
rejected.reason: Yields are Nigeria-wide chart values, not labelled Lagos or Abuja; no yield definition or publication date in the text read. Not entered as district records. Context only.
